learning_pr.title: Implement account-free Study practice and durable guest recovery
learning_pr.body:
Adds account-free prepared Study practice with durable browser ownership, server-scored spoken answers, saved-result recovery, retention and proof-authorized audio deletion. The Worker requires explicit nonproduction composition and concrete native readiness for four distinct restricted PostgreSQL roles. Current limits/disclosure gate new paid work; accepted checkpoints recover their original resource and provider result without redispatch.

Sixteen learning declarations are source-admitted. Five accounting declarations and reward-capable mode remain unavailable. Source migrations 0248–0263 and a regenerated baseline/reset preserve ordinary Account/Karaoke ownership; immutable client 0.118.0 preserves all historical releases and operation wire shapes. Production remains paused; this PR does not apply live migrations, provision roles, deploy, activate features or perform funded operations.

Validation:
- Four native readiness cases and three canonical default Worker/native/HNS journeys pass. External provider/storage/host boundaries are local fixtures.
- Fresh native public preparedness and private Study journey: nine cases pass, covering original COMMIT recovery, saved-checkpoint replay and late audio/deletion reconciliation. Five native authority cases also pass.
- Both TypeScript projects, freshness, immutable package/clean-consumer verification, exact-main breaking comparison and 60 focused cases pass; full maintained check passes.
- Broad local suite: 5,996 unit cases, 24 SQLite/DO cases and 22 Node cases pass, with three existing environment skips and both fresh media completion markers verified. Workerd reached 52 passing cases, then nine suites stopped on an existing exported-module resolver gap. The reviewed source-resolution correction and fresh remaining Workerd/full checks are pending.

Draft canonical acceptance requires final matched-head local and hosted checks and independent source/artifact acceptance. The frozen learning/client custody handoff follows acceptance; accounting then proceeds serially with guest UI in parallel under the frozen contract. Shared financial scheduler composition and composed staging recovery remain separate acceptance work.
